title.value: Optimal local and remote controllers with unreliable uplink channels: An elementary proof
title.justification: The title clearly captures the essence of the study which focuses on providing an elementary proof to a problem involving optimal local and remote controllers in a specific network scenario.
title.quote: Optimal local and remote controllers with unreliable uplink channels: An elementary proof

analysis.description: This paper provides an alternative and elementary proof for the results of a decentralized control system with non-classical information structures, presenting a simpler solution methodology compared to previous complex dynamic programming techniques.

type.justification: The paper primarily focuses on providing an alternative proof and theoretical insights into the optimal control strategies for decentralized systems.
type.quote: In this technical note, we provide an alternative and ele- mentary proof of the result of [1].

name.justification: The paper deals with decentralized control systems and optimal control strategies over unreliable channels, which falls under the domain of control systems.
name.quote: Recently, a model of a decentralized control system with local and remote controllers connected over unreliable channels was presented in [1].

name.justification: The paper specifically discusses control strategies in the context of unreliable network channels, which is related to networked control systems.
name.quote: The model proposed in [1] is a decentralized control system with non-classical information structure.
